finding.claim: The r5 tests are weaker than the row. test_opencode_rule_matches_the_claude_rule skips the byte comparison when .claude/rules/<rule>.md is absent, which it is on any checkout without an install. test_opencode_rules_come_from_both_install_recipes rejects only a `.claude/rules/*` glob, so a recipe that also copies an eighth rule by name (for example minimal-comments.md) still passes, though the row's fails_when names "a rule outside the 7 is copied".

fixes.change: The recipe test now requires the set of rules copied by name to equal the 7, so an eighth rule fails it; the byte test's docstring names r8 as the clean-checkout proof.
